body: Alex is an absolute delight and a consummate professional. A perfectionist at her craft.
author: Suzanne H.

body: Alex is fantastic - a completely relaxing massage and facial while also addressing tension and knots. Would highly recommend!
author: Julia N.

body: A friend of mine recommended Alex to me for leg, bikini, underarm wax and lash lift before my Greek holiday! I'm a fairly new mum and still a bit body conscious, and Alex was amazing. I felt comfortable and I feel great, my skin feels amazing and my lashes look great.
author: Chanele C.

body: Alex is worth every penny. I was suffering from chronic dizziness and migraines, until I started having massages with Alex. She has genuinely given me back my health, and I can't thank her enough!
author: Claudine S.

body: A wonderful salon in a perfect rural location, much nicer than having to battle the traffic getting in to town and having to pay for parking.
author: Stuart C.

body: My daughter and I ❤️ Alex.  She is professional and always give 5 star treatments. Alex is the only therapist in the world who I would trust with my feet ☺️
author: Nicola H.

body: AMAZING. I had a gel manicure and pedicure and it really is the best I've ever had. Alex is lovely and very professional and I would highly recommend.
author: Jacqueline D.

body: I was extremely happy with the treatments I had with Alex , she's a lovely person and makes you feel very comfortable also very easy to park at her salon. Can't wait to book another treatment 😊
author: Amber H.

body: Hands down the best massage we've had. Would highly recommend Alex, such a lovely lady and a very welcoming salon vibe.
author: Sophie M.

body: Alex is very professional and an all round lovely lady who I would highly recommend.
author: Kath W.

body: Have been using Alex for couple of years now. Pedicures and manicures are great. Tried the reflexology that she has recently qualified for. A must!!

body: The salon is clean, bright and a very comforting space. Would highly recommend.
